items.name: Cannabinoid Potency | Preparation of Flower/Plant Samples | Centrifuge
items.description:
This protocol step is to document the preparation of flower/plant samples. It gives the steps from Cannabinoid Potency Assay SOP, Section 8.7.5 through 8.7.7.

8.7.7	Centrifuge the samples at ≥3000 rpm for 5 minutes.
items.worksheet_name: Cannabinoid Potency {Protocol WS} Preparation of Flower/Plant Samples Centrifuge

items.name: Cannabinoid Potency | Preparation of Flower/Plant Samples | Filter/Dilution
items.description:
This protocol step is to document the preparation of flower/plant samples. It gives the steps from Cannabinoid Potency Assay SOP, Section 8.7.8 through 8.7.9.

8.7.8	Attach a clean, 0.2 µm PTFE filter to a syringe and dispense contents into a new 5 mL tube (DF=40).
8.7.9	Dilute the samples with ACN (if needed). Common dilution factors include: 
•	Hemp Flower: 400x – 600x
•	Marijuana Flower: 1000x – 1500x
•	Proficiency Hemp Flower: 100x & 500x
items.worksheet_name: Cannabinoid Potency {Protocol WS} Preparation of Flower/Plant Samples Filter

items.name: Cannabinoid Potency | Preparation of Flower/Plant Samples | Step 1
items.description: Add 20.0 mL of ACN to the 0.5 g of plant sample in the 50 mL conical tube
items.worksheet_name: Cannabinoid Potency {Protocol WS} Preparation of Flower/Plant Samples

items.name: Cannabinoid Potency | Preparation of Flower/Plant Samples | Vortex/Sonicate
items.description:
This protocol step is to document the preparation of flower/plant samples. It gives the steps from Cannabinoid Potency Assay SOP, Section 8.7.5 through 8.7.6.

8.7.5	Vortex sample at speed 10 for 5 minutes, then sonicate for 5 minutes.
8.7.6	Vortex sample at speed 10 for 1 minute, then sonicate for 5 minutes.
items.worksheet_name: Cannabinoid Potency {Protocol WS} Preparation of Flower/Plant Samples Vortex/Sonicate
